decisions.reason: A newly launched lever handle family fits the firm's core coordinated-range strategy, and early results give no evidence of a shortfall that would trigger search for alternatives.
The mitred handle family extends the firm's design-led core range, and one year is too short to judge it against aspiration, so an established hardware maker with slack would carry it.
The multifunctional handle supports the barrier-free and hygiene system direction, so management sees no reason to drop it this soon.
This lever handle line sits within the firm's core competence and draws on shared manufacturing, so its carrying cost is low and keeping it is the satisficing choice.
The collection won the German Design Award and has its own web page, so its results clearly exceed aspirations.
The patinated bronze finish uses the firm's proprietary finishing capability across existing product families at low incremental cost, so there is little pressure to drop it.
